db_path.description: Absolute path to alternate database file (app-only; equivalent to --db)

browser.description: Fallback browser to use, overriding the system default (equivalent to BROWSER env)

editor.description: Editor command for --write (e.g., 'vim -f'; overrides EDITOR env)

colors.description: Five-letter ANSI color string (index title URL description comment tag)

threads.description: Max number of parallel network threads for full DB refresh (1–10)

auto_import.description: Auto-import bookmarks from default browser profiles on startup

import_tags_from_folders.description: Import parent folder names as tags during HTML/JSON import

default_import_tags.description: Tags to prepend to all newly added bookmarks during import or add

immutable_by_default.description: Set immutable flag on all newly added bookmarks

tag_delimiter.description: Tag delimiter (must be ',' per buku design)

default_count.description: Number of results shown per page (1–100)

prompt_keys_disabled.description: Disable interactive prompt keys (for scripted use)

disable_color.description: Disable ANSI color codes in output

open_in_background.description: Open results in background (e.g., non-blocking browser calls)

offline_by_default.description: Disable network fetch by default for add/update

suggest_tags.description: Show similar tag suggestions when adding a bookmark

tag_redirect_pattern.description: Pattern for redirect tag, where '{}' is replaced by status or URL scheme

error_tag_pattern.description: Pattern for error tag, where '{}' is replaced by HTTP status code

del_error_codes.description: Comma-separated HTTP status codes to delete on error (e.g., '404,500')

url_redirect.description: Follow permanent redirects when fetching titles/descriptions

firefox_profile.description: Firefox profile name for auto-import (overrides FIREFOX_PROFILE env)
